description: PICTURE format 2 - the LOCALE phrase ({PICTURE|PIC} IS character-string-1 LOCALE [IS locale-name-1] SIZE IS integer-1), ISO 13.18.40.2 - introduced 2002 with the locale facility (Annex A.4.9 item 8; kb/Work PB64 T6): a fixed-point numeric-edited item (13.18.40.4 GR16) of integer-1 character positions (GR17) whose editing is the locale's LC_MONETARY (13.18.40.5 r9-r15; CobolLocaleEdit). Parse-arm gated on recognition (VisitPictureClause on pictureLocalePhrase presence; the predicate is NOT edition-gated - the ORDER TABLE precedent - so the gate, not a raw parse error at SIZE, answers below 2002).
vcr: 2002 introduction (the locale facility; kb/Work PB64 T6 - locale editing over the ONE LC_MONETARY model)
